summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a warrant inducement agreement with a holder to exercise existing warrants for cash. The agreement reduced the exercise price from $3.62 to $1.35 per share for 3,341,439 shares, generating roughly $4.5 million gross proceeds. As consideration, the company issued new warrants to purchase up to 5,012,159 shares at $1.65, representing 150% of the exercised shares, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The new warrants become exercisable upon stockholder approval and expire five years later. The transaction closed on August 3, 2026. This is a capital-raising mechanism, not a classic special situation; watch for Nasdaq approval and registration filing.
